positions.as_written: Expect the damping loss after meniscectomy to show in impact activities rather than in walking.
Treat muscle as the modifiable shock absorber when the meniscal contribution has been lost.
Treat damping as the meniscal function with the weakest quantitative evidence and a sound mechanism.
Advise on impact activity in a meniscus deficient knee on mechanistic grounds, and say so.
Expect a substitute not to reproduce native damping properties.
